entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Champions of Corruption
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Sometimes, you have to break things if you want people to get your point.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Power Attack, Intimidate 1 rank.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can attempt to smash an unattended inanimate object while attempting an Intimidate check (see Smashing an Object). If you break the object, you gain a bonus to the Intimidate check equal to half its hardness (minimum +1). If you destroy the object, the bonus is equal to its hardness (minimum +1). Creatures intimidated by this feat cannot be affected by it again for 24 hours.
